separateNative50MpPngGate.scope: Actual image import, original preservation, WASM edit, save/reopen and native PNG export.

native50MpLimits: SVG mask regression preserves real 10000x5000 source bytes/dimensions and fifty native coverage tiles. Ten decoded native-coordinate crops verify seam coverage; this is not a full 50 MP filtered SVG raster decode, peak-memory, p95 or device benchmark.
developmentFindings: Parent SVG filters clipped nested child shadows despite explicit filter/primitive regions. Transparent input support geometry restores overflow; the failed nested masked/unmasked alpha maxima 121/145 become <=2 after correction.

The native renderer colors the masked silhouette before blur. Matching that graph order removes the observed ordinary colored soft-edge differences and gives exact fixture output, instead of coloring blurred alpha afterward.

Remaining native/SVG intermediate rounding is measured, with separate strict simple-case, affine/native-mask and nested-chain limits. Independent color/area/centroid/shadow-only and off-canvas goldens remain strict.

Initial unit planner fixtures mistakenly supplied a Document instead of its serialization; corrected to the private read-only DTO boundary. Extra affine fixtures initially placed Node assertions inside browser evaluation; fixed in the harness without changing product behavior.
limitations: Transparent support rectangles can enlarge downstream SVG group selection bounds. Original paths and editor model geometry are unchanged.
Viewer SVG filter/antialiasing/intermediate rounding and working-memory/precision behavior can differ from native PNG. No universal bit-exact interoperability claim.
Native mask preparation remains tiled, but retained compressed/base64 output and viewer filter decoding consume memory. Individual mask/encoding calls are not preemptible.
Blend If and raster/paint/text/adjustment/smart contents remain omitted and reported; omitted content can change shadows, overlays and blend backdrops.
General SVG document import/round-trip, editable raster-mask geometry, broader format/precision/RAW/workflow/AI/commercial/specialist roadmap and human/device gates remain incomplete.
